observations: Original/autotuned outputs show no visible difference in these four standing160px regions for either checkpoint.
Both10k models still retain substantial colored sky/building grain and weak noisy foliage/fence structure. Autotuning does not repair that model-quality limitation.
The sharper independently demosaiced ISO100 f/5.6 image remains a qualitative reference, not exact GT; scene time/aperture/moving subjects differ.

scope: Same actual10k models/raw/physical recipe and frozen FP32 path, four fresh serial processes with opposite within-arm policy order and16GiB allocator cap. All611975112 unquantized RGB values pass unchanged1DN16 max/.25DN16 RMS. Every candidate RGB16 value matches declared F32 quantization; native16triplets/24cells actually viewed, no resampling. Real ISO100 reference is not GT. No SOTA, training speed, idle-machine optimum, repeat-run CI or sub10s claim.
